title: Real Research Today: Sleeper Ships
definition: Today's documented research behind Sleeper Ships.
description:
The road to Sleeper Ships is already being paved. Icarus Interstellar is a nonprofit research network designing theoretical interstellar spacecraft. The Voyager probes, launched in 1977, are the only human objects in interstellar space.

Breakthrough Starshot proposes gram-scale light-sail probes pushed by Earth-based lasers toward Alpha Centauri. Together these programs form the biostasis foundation that Sleeper Ships will build on — the hibernation propulsion results, the metabolic suspension methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as hibernation propulsion research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2032 — First long-duration crew rotation testbed runs a sealed cryo hul
title: 2032 — First long-duration crew rotation testbed runs a sealed cryo hul
definition: 2032 milestone on the Sleeper Ships roadmap.
description:
First long-duration crew rotation testbed runs a sealed cryo hull habitat for 1,000 days on Earth, proving the biostasis recycling math.

What must be true first: the biostasis results have to replicate outside the lab, hibernation propulsion manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and metabolic suspension operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

title: Readiness Estimator: Sleeper Ships
definition: Estimates Sleeper Ships readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Sleeper Ships components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a cryo hull that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Sleeper Ships Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Sleeper Ships: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Sleeper Ships — starships whose crews sleep through the centuries between stars.

Phase 1 — Prove (biostasis): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (hibernation propulsion): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (metabolic suspension): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (crew rotation): cryo hull as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and interstellar dark-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
